Major US growth data is dropping today, and active traders need to be ready.

At 08:30 ET, the second estimate for US Q3 GDP hits the tape. Markets are looking for 3.4%, following 2.2% in the initial reading.
[ON SCREEN: Forecast 3.4% vs Previous 2.2%]
